title: Valid Palindrome III
description: Determine if string s is a k-palindrome, meaning it can become a palindrome by removing at most k characters.
pseudocode:
1. n = s.length
2. dp[n][n] table initialized to 0
3. Fill dp for substrings: if s[i] == s[j], dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1]
4. Else, dp[i][j] = 1 + min(dp[i+1][j], dp[i][j-1])
5. Return dp[0][n-1] <= k

steps.note: Initialize variables with s = 'abcde', k = 2. Length n = 5.
Create 5x5 DP table where dp[i][j] represents min deletions for s[i...j].
Calculating substring 'abcde'. Since 'a' != 'e', take 1 + min(dp[0][3], dp[1][4]).
Result dp[0][4] is 4. Since 4 > k (2), return false.
